component: Extension spaces module and file naming

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The extraction registers ExtensionSpaces.sys.mjs in EXTRA_JS_MODULES, imports SpaceTracker in ext-mail.js and creates one global tracker. Both APIs import native conversion helpers from the same module. New nearby privileged extension modules can follow this ExtensionRole.sys.mjs family and keep imports/moz.build in sync. Parent ext-*.js API files remain a different established family. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Use the shared spaces module and its packaged file name
